title: Email proof database operations
responsibility: Provide email proof, send-rate and verified-address storage methods.

inputs.name: d1EmailStores.db
inputs.description: A D1-compatible handle whose prepared statements support the bind, first, and run calls used by these stores. It is needed when a store method executes SQL.

inputs.name: d1EmailStores.records
inputs.description: Validator instance that converts rows read by proof lookups and verified-email lookups into typed records. Rows must satisfy the validator's field and value constraints or validation throws.

outputs.name: EMAIL_PURGES
outputs.description: An ordered array of SQL deletes for proofs and verified emails with expires_at <= the supplied cutoff, and send rows whose last_sent_at is at least 172800000 ms old. The caller must bind the cutoff and execute each statement.

outputs.name: d1EmailStores
outputs.description: An object containing the D1-backed emailProofs and emailLedger stores, wired to this database handle and row validator. Proof issuance and attempts use live/unclaimed/time/attempt conditions, while send allowance checks the interval and day cap atomically; conditional methods return false or null when no row matches.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: When a database row passed to records.emailProof or records.verifiedEmail violates the validator's field or value constraints, AuthRecordValidator throws Error('Hub auth record corrupt') rather than coercing the row.
